old: Example: VA Disability ($1,800) + GI Bill BAH ($2,800) + VA Work-Study ($600) = $5,200/mo tax-free while earning your degree. That's more take-home than many E-6s. Build your stack.
new: Use your confirmed pay and benefit decisions to plan your budget. GI Bill housing payments depend on eligibility, duty status and training or enrollment. VA Work Study requires a separate application and approved work. Check payment timing with VA and your school before counting on income.
